description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Business Intelligence Developer based in the United States. 

 As a Business Intelligence Developer, you will transform complex datasets into meaningful insights, intelligent analytics tools, and actionable recommendations for mission-driven organizations. You will play a key role in developing an audience intelligence platform that brings together donor interactions, campaign performance, engagement activities, and other behavioral data. Working closely with product management and data engineering teams, you will design AI-enabled dashboards, interactive visualizations, and analytical solutions that help organizations make better-informed decisions. You will also establish consistent performance metrics, improve data quality, and translate business requirements into effective technical solutions. This fully remote opportunity is ideal for an analytical and collaborative professional who enjoys building innovative data products and making advanced analytics accessible to a wide range of users.



Accountabilities:
 
 You will lead the development of business intelligence tools and data-driven product capabilities, ensuring that complex information is transformed into clear, reliable, and actionable insights. Your responsibilities will include:


 
 Business Intelligence and Visualization: Design, develop, and test AI-enabled analytics tools, dashboards, and data visualizations that highlight key audience intelligence metrics, including engagement, activation, retention, and attribution.



 
 Data Analysis and Insights: Analyze campaign, CRM, donor, and audience data to identify meaningful patterns, behavioral trends, and opportunities for improved engagement and performance.



 
 AI-Driven Development: Apply AI-native thinking and AI-enabled development approaches to create innovative analytical tools and improve the delivery of business intelligence solutions.



 
 Product Collaboration: Work closely with product management teams to develop user-focused features incorporating relevant metrics, benchmarks, and data visualization best practices.



 
 Data Engineering Coordination: Collaborate with data engineering partners to define technical specifications, use cases, and requirements for data models and analytics infrastructure.



 
 Metrics Definition and Documentation: Establish, document, and maintain the business logic behind core product KPIs to ensure consistency, accuracy, and trust in reported metrics.



 
 Data Quality and Testing: Validate dashboard outputs, investigate data inconsistencies, and participate in user acceptance testing (UAT) for new analytics features.



 
 Client Data Onboarding: Support client onboarding by reviewing data mappings, interpreting source data formats, and recommending appropriate visualization and reporting approaches.



 
 Technology Assessment: Evaluate available technologies and make recommendations to product and technology leadership based on business requirements, technical feasibility, and product objectives.



 
 Continuous Improvement: Work iteratively, test solutions early, and refine analytics products based on user feedback, evolving business needs, and emerging technologies.




 Requirements: 

 The ideal candidate is an experienced business intelligence professional with strong technical expertise, a product-oriented mindset, and the ability to communicate complex analytical concepts clearly. You should be comfortable working independently while collaborating across multidisciplinary teams and translating user needs into practical data solutions. The following qualifications and skills are expected:


 
 At least 5 years of experience in data-driven business intelligence, preferably working with product teams to develop products and services for external clients or customers.



 
 At least 3 years of hands-on experience building data visualizations and dashboards using tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Amazon QuickSight, Hex, Sigma, ThoughtSpot, or Looker.



 
 At least 1 year of practical experience in AI-enabled business intelligence development.



 
 Understanding and experience with semantic data models and semantic layers.



 
 Demonstrated ability to create interactive, multi-layered dashboards and effective data visualizations.



 
 Strong proficiency in SQL and the ability to independently query and analyze large datasets.



 
 Experience working with marketing and CRM data, including campaign engagement, audience segmentation, and donation trends.



 
 Understanding of customer journeys, conversion funnels, engagement metrics, and donor lifecycle analysis.



 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn complex datasets into actionable business recommendations.



 
 Excellent communication skills and the ability to translate between user needs, product capabilities, technical requirements, and business outcomes.



 
 Ability to work effectively in ambiguous environments, take initiative, and move projects forward through testing and iterative development.



 
 Collaborative mindset, with a willingness to share knowledge, support colleagues, and build strong working relationships.



 
 Confidence in communicating recommendations, influencing decisions, and providing clear direction when needed.



 
 Enthusiasm, adaptability, and a proactive approach to continuous learning and improvement.




 Preferred Qualifications:


 
 Experience using and developing APIs to access, integrate, and analyze complex datasets.



 
 Experience building analytics products for external customers or users.



 
 Familiarity with AI-powered analytics platforms and emerging business intelligence technologies.




 Benefits :


 
 Fully remote work opportunity.



 
 Professional development and continuous learning opportunities.



 
 Opportunity to contribute to innovative, AI-driven data products and analytics solutions.



 
 Collaborative working environment that encourages knowledge sharing, creativity, and cross-functional teamwork.



 
 Opportunity to support mission-driven organizations through better data insights and audience intelligence.



 
 Inclusive workplace that values diverse perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences.



 
 Reasonable accommodations for qualified applicants with disabilities throughout the recruitment process.
